subject.title: feat(chat-ui): inline diffs for edit and write tool rows

question: Should arbitrary write/overwrite rows retain the web UI’s inferred +N −0 statistic, or should both native and web UIs omit an exact statistic until the result contract can distinguish create from overwrite?
rationale: The branch intentionally follows the current web behavior, but the gateway result does not establish the previous file contents, so only maintainers can choose the durable cross-platform presentation contract.

options.title: Use authoritative-only write statistics
options.body: Omit an exact write diffstat unless a result supplies authoritative before/after data, while keeping a bounded content preview.

options.title: Keep inferred parity
options.body: Retain +N −0 for writes across platforms and document that it represents submitted content rather than a verified filesystem delta.

recommendation.title: Use authoritative-only write statistics
recommendation.body: Omit an exact write diffstat unless a result supplies authoritative before/after data, while keeping a bounded content preview.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged tool-row foundation and the current parity-oriented implementation.
